factories.name: settings_read

Distinct admin/settings_operator/read_operator subjects, real allowed/denied settings reads and compiled cookie UI. One local browser GET is transport-aborted; its receipt has no server status/AM, subsequent real recovery response is retained, and both AMs are read. Parent disposal owns immutable read audits.

factories.name: settings_conflict
factories.requires: Parent settings lease; disabled autonomous policies and actual compatible budget writers; two compiled cookie browser sessions. Local-proxy fault forwards one PUT without retries/redirects, withholds only an observed 2xx response and retains subsequent dispatches/errors through cleanup. Distinct disabled owner-policy drafts are input data; case owns public writes/restoration, parent owns database disposal.

factories.name: automatic_pause
factories.requires: Exclusive settings lease with auto-pause initially disabled; distinct active idle/busy/Always-on Sandbox cohort and readBusyWork(ctx,sandbox) raw identity/progress/restarts; actual parent public revival/native cleanup. Case owns 60-second monotonic grace wait; more than 90 seconds remaining required before setup/enabling, configure executable_case_budget_ms with setup and scanner headroom (for example 180000). No waitIdleThreshold verdict.

factories.name: measured_visibility
factories.requires: Exclusive settings lease; fixed historical integer range {from,to}; scopes.user/admin with distinct actual cookie subjects and complete stable sandboxIds cohorts of 1-50 each; real CPU measurement gaps and unchanged allocation inputs. Case validates completed report, inventory, all required charts and exact null-gap UI rows. No completedUsage or measurementGapMarker oracle; parent owns immutable report/audit disposal and native finality. See measured-visibility.md.

factories.name: settings_retention
factories.requires: Built-in public settings read under parent exclusive lease; actual compiled admin cookie UI. Exact retention PUT/revision/serving receipt and both-AM policy join; unsigned UI negatives dispatch no settings write and API negatives return typed 422 without effects. Source-defined report prefetch has separate exact admission receipts; close/drain before one fresh-CAS restoration. Parent disposal owns immutable audits and prefetched reports. See retention.md.

factories.name: user_limit
factories.requires: Concrete parent-bound createUserLimitFactory({userResources}) recipe supplied; parent still binds a genuinely empty disposable user for each repetition, distinct admin/user subjects, pinned profile, subordinate resource custody with retainRefusal, disabled background policies and independent native finality. Three unique public intents are retained before dispatch; accepted and typed-refusal receipts resolve original intents, unknown outcomes never replay. Settings lease is already held; do not nest it.

factories.name: visitor_limits
factories.requires: Exact unprivileged visitor and compiled cookie admin settings UI. Two Sandbox POST intents and three public Trigger Launch POST intents have unique original keys; custody(intent,{actor,am}) returns capture(response) and memoized cleanup before dispatch. Retain full accepted/refused/attribution-error responses, unknown outcomes and actual ingress. Independent public inventory must match exact accepted IDs. Public root and Launch cleanup plus native finality remain parent-owned; no automatic factory.

factories.name: trigger_settings
factories.requires: Actual published disposable Trigger with empty per-trigger user Launch inventory, no publisher review, no required services and empty first message. Return triggerId/publicId, two disabledIntents and one launchIntent: unique original user POST keys, exact public Launch route, body {start_if_ready:true,choice:new}; custody returns full capture and memoized cleanup before dispatch. The case reads actual public Launch ID/state/blocked_reason/resolution and both-AM inventories; no occurrence_id or scheduler oracle. Parent still owns authenticated publication, original unknown-outcome custody, public cancellation/root cleanup and native/database finality.

factories.name: idle_preview

Snapshot actual lifecycle/work fields and complete contiguous events with after cursor, maximum 20 pages of 200; bound exhaustion fails. Actual preview response joins serving receipt. Browser close/drain precedes final read-only and lifecycle checks, including late mutations and independent failures. Parent fixture remains required.

factories.name: idle_pause
factories.requires: Exclusive scanner cohort with distinct active idle/busy/Always-on IDs and quiescent Sandbox lifecycle/work; real compiled admin cookie UI. readBusyWork(ctx,sandbox) returns actual sandbox_id, agent_id, turn_sequence, runtime_id, progress sequence and native restarts for each held busy turn before and after dispatch. Unconfirmed refusal preserves complete lifecycle/events; one confirmed UI POST joins actual serving receipt, closes/drains, then both AMs must show completed pause and unchanged protected lifecycle. Parent owns public revival, held-turn cleanup, native finality and database disposal; no automatic factory.

factories.name: defaults_marketplace

Profiles retire before settings-lease release; no create replay or automatic readiness.

factories.name: settings_audit

factories.name: spend_availability
factories.requires: Exclusive parent settings lease; authentic setWriterAvailability(boolean) changes only the real model-budget writer gate on both serving AMs and preserves durable settings/revision and other flags. Baseline model_budget and model_request_budget writers true; valid whole-second platform period plus default or explicit owner policy, retained lists, and platform_spend writer true when cloud policy exists. Parent owns bounded mode evidence and actual compiled admin cookie session, never mocked flags/responses. Case performs one typed503 full PUT and one successful exact full PUT, proves every retained control and both-AM snapshots, and closes/drains before original-policy restoration. One memoized writer recovery serves normal/cleanup paths; unknown outcomes stay failed without replay. Parent cleanup disposes immutable audits/reports and must preserve unresolved mode custody. Six automatic/31 parent-required counts unchanged.

Optional platform fields preserved; close/drain before one fresh-CAS restoration. Parent exclusive lease, compiled cookie UI and audit/report database disposal required. See spend-period.md.

factories.name: admission_read
factories.requires: Exclusive admission lease; at least21 public-created transitions and twenty retained newest-first entries on the same disposable database. Authentic parent setWriteAvailability(boolean) selects the real admitted writer mode on both serving AMs without changing durable control; intent precedes the call, and one memoized restoration returns the original mode. Initially unavailable mode is preserved without enabling it. Both-AM raw GET receipts prove the gate and unchanged durable control before and after each original typed-refusal POST; the finalizer independently reads both AMs even on restoration failure. Parent bounds and retains mode transitions, owns immutable history/database disposal, and cannot synthesize availability or repair a committed refused command.

factories.name: trigger_commands

Public Launch state, both-AM inventory/settings and complete actor-filtered audit pages prove behavior; no occurrence or worker-result oracle. Cleanup cancels a blocked Launch or retires completed roots before policy restoration; immutable Launch/audit records remain until parent database disposal.

factories.name: spend_read
factories.requires: Exclusive settings lease and authentic bounded selectMode(enabled/disabled/dependency_unavailable/enabled_without_cloud) plus restoreMode() capturing the initial real mode. Supply expectedEnabled, expectedDisabled and expectedWithoutCloud from exact prepared local accounting data, never a case-result oracle. Enabled needs a real cloud observation and positive committed value stable over the admitted case budget; cloud policy requires positive run rate and maximum age. enabled_without_cloud means configured cloud policy with an absent observation/committed field, not absent cloud policy. Dependency fault targets the real ledger reader with service/authentication still installed. Both-AM public settings derive mode/revision/levels; all modes exercise exact non-operator403 with no private accounting fields. One restoration precedes independent both-AM settings/spend proof, preserving initial policy/ledger and allowing only a justified new settings revision. Parent owns mode evidence and immutable database disposal; healthy bound42GETs/four selections/one restoration. No automatic factory.

factories.name: spend_observation
factories.requires: Exclusive settings lease and isolated quiescent platform cloud ledger; real metering and platform_spend_writes_available=true on both AMs. Supply positive safe units and a fresh in-period observedThrough in exact YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ form, later than any current cloud observation; no fractional timestamp or previously recorded instant. Parent setWritesAvailable(boolean) selects the real admitted gate on both AMs while preserving settings/database. Case posts one original observation, exercises eight invalid variants plus unavailable and forbidden refusals on both AMs, and proves complete durable ledger/no-effect state while retaining raw time-projected committed values. Unknown writes never replay or repair; one memoized gate restoration precedes independent both-AM settings/spend reads. Parent bounds mode changes and owns immutable observation/audit history plus database disposal; no automatic factory.
